name: connect-second-window
description: A second window in a workspace with no daemon opens the Connect screen instead of printing /connect status text. It cannot act on the network (the first window owns it), so the screen shows the network and this device, says so in one plain line, and offers no code, requests or accept/reject keys; /connect code and a workspace with no network say the same. The first window keeps the full screen. Checked at 80 and 120 columns (issue #121, Story 1).

setup.description: throwaway HOME with two workspaces; ws is on an offline network, ws2 is on none
setup.command: R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-connect-second-window"; rm -rf "$H"; mkdir -p "$H/.kollab" "$H/ws" "$H/ws2"; printf '%s' '{"kollabor":{"llm":{"active_profile":"openai-test","profiles":{"openai-test":{"provider":"openai","model":"gpt-5.5","base_url":"https://api.openai.com/v1","api_key":"sk-test-dummy","supports_tools":true}}}},"plugins":{"hub":{"enabled":true}}}' > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; ln -sfn "$R/plugins" "$H/ws/plugins"; ln -sfn "$R/plugins" "$H/ws2/plugins"; cd "$H/ws" && HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$R/.venv/bin/python" -c "from plugins.hub.project_scope import resolve_project_root as root; from plugins.hub.relay_state import RelayStateStore as Store; s = Store(root(), None); s.state.origin = 'https://relay.invalid'; s.state.device_name = 'laptop-kollab'; s.save()"

setup.description: start the first window of each workspace (they own the relay) and wait until both hold it
setup.command: R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-connect-second-window"; S=kollab-spec-second-window; tmux -L $S kill-server 2>/dev/null; for w in ws ws2; do tmux -L $S new-session -d -s owner-$w -x 80 -y 30 && tmux -L $S send-keys -t owner-$w -l "cd $H/$w && env HOME=$H KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 PYTHONPATH=$R $R/.venv/bin/python $R/main.py --no-daemon" && tmux -L $S send-keys -t owner-$w Enter; done; for i in $(seq 1 80); do [ $(find "$H/.kollab/network" -name relay-owner.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -ge 2 ] && break; sleep 0.5; done; [ $(find "$H/.kollab/network" -name relay-owner.json | wc -l) -ge 2 ]
